items.desc: Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute.
items.readme: improve An agent skill that audits any codebase and writes implementation plans for other agents to execute. The idea: use your most capable model for the part where intelligence compounds — understanding the codebase, judging what's worth doing, writing the spec — and hand execution to cheaper models. The skill never implements anything itself. The plan is the product. Install Works in any agent that supports Agent Skills format. The plans it writes are plain markdown, so any agent (or human) can pick them up. items.desc: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
items.readme: agent-browser Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. `snapshot` returns the page as compact text with a ref such as `@e1` for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. Install Homebrew:** `brew install agent-browser`, then `agent-browser install`. Linux:** `agent-browser install --with-deps` also installs the browser's system libraries.
